title: Rectangular prism base
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and a translation vector of [0.3671, 0.0, 0.0]. On the first face, draw a two-dimensional sketch consisting of a rectangular loop. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.3829, 0.0). The second line extends from (0.3829, 0.0) to (0.3829, 0.1863). The third line goes from (0.3829, 0.1863) to (0.0, 0.1863), and the fourth line completes the rectangle by connecting (0.0, 0.1863) back to the origin. Scale this two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.3829. Transform the scaled sketch into three dimensions by applying the same Euler angles and translation vector used initially. Extrude the transformed sketch 0.1035 units along the normal direction to create a three-dimensional solid body. The final dimensions of the rectangular prism base are 0.3828845079173208 units in length, 0.18626813898680472 units in width, and 0.10348229943711373 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.3829, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.3829, 0.1863) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.1863) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.1035)

# Translate the object
r = r.translate((0.3671, 0.0, 0.0))

# The final model is represented as 'r'
